summary: Mailbox for any game: letters with rewards, publisher broadcasts, gifts from friends, resource transfers and missed rewards of other systems — with 'Claim all'.
description: A ready mailbox screen for ANY game, built on the @idosgames/react/ui kit and client.mailbox. Tabs by category (all, rewards, gifts, system); a letter opens with its text in the player's language, the sender, a banner, the rewards and a button to the screen or page the letter links to. 'Claim' per letter and 'Claim all' in one server operation; rewards of other systems the player has not taken yet (leaderboard cycle, team event prize, invite rewards) are shown on top and claimed right here. 'Send gifts': a free daily gift to friends ('to everyone' in one tap) and a transfer of own coins or items to one friend — declined or expired transfers come back. 'Delete read' cleans up. The lobby badge counts unread letters and rewards waiting. The server owns everything: limits, friendship, expiry, what can be transferred. Opens straight on a friend with ctx.features.open('mailbox', { friendUserID, mode: 'gift' | 'transfer' }) — the friends system does that from a friend's card. Registers the 'mailbox' feature, hidden until the title turns the mailbox on. Ships title-seed.json: the mailbox on, a welcome template, a daily coin gift and coin/potion transfers.
provides: letters with rewards and claim all
